close_reason: Skeleton created: Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs. Builds and passes clippy -D warnings. Implementation stubs (check_algorithm, check_extensions, RustCryptoVerifier) tracked for v0.1 impl work.
description: Create a 4th crate pkix-chain-simple that provides a strict, opinionated chain verifier. Accepts only the small subset of cert configurations seen in common TLS/code-signing chains. If ANYTHING is unusual (long chain, non-standard algorithm, unexpected extension), it returns an error rather than trying to handle it. API: verify_simple(chain, anchors, now_unix) with no verifier or revocation params.
title: Add pkix-chain-simple crate skeleton
